name: UN Comtrade API
tagline: UN official API for global merchandise trade statistics by country, product, and partner
description: The UN Comtrade API provides official global trade statistics by reporter, partner, commodity classification, period, and trade flow. Tightly limited preview APIs work without an account or key. Registered free users can obtain a subscription key for broader Data API access, while premium subscriptions add bulk and asynchronous APIs, larger per-call limits, and higher daily quotas.

auth.details: Primary key (subscription key) via Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key header after free self-serve registration at comtradedeveloper.un.org; also accepted as subscription-key query parameter

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free Basic Individual: up to 500 API calls/day and 100,000 Data API records per call.
pricing.paid_plans: Premium/enterprise products via UN Comtrade developer portal; contact UN for bulk/commercial licensing

rate_limits: Free: ~500 requests/day; premium tiers higher — confirm exact product quotas on comtradedeveloper.un.org
use_cases: get annual HS trade totals for a reporter country and partner
list merchandise import/export values by commodity code and year
pull multi-year trade series for economic research or dashboards
compare bilateral trade flows between two countries
export Comtrade query results as CSV for offline analysis
